title: Agent as Content Producer
decision_boundary: May this agent-produced artefact be accepted as produced under a valid, in-scope mandate and declared transformation policy at the evaluated decision time?

cases.condition: recognized agent, valid principal mandate, and in-scope action/resource/purpose
recognized agent but action, resource, purpose, recipient, transformation, or tool is outside mandate
principal authority or agent delegation is revoked at the evaluated decision time
required authority, delegation, policy, or revocation evidence is stale or unavailable
authoritative sources or material verifier dependencies return incompatible results
material provenance, mandate, scope, or authority evidence is corrected after the original decision

limitations: The result establishes scoped production authority and provenance state; it does not establish factual truth of the content.
A production mandate does not confer submission, publication, verification, or decision authority.
